When the Gnome or Artificer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.

An opponent is unable to block and kill Delina and Lightning Runner.

Declare Delina and Lightning Runner as attackers, triggering Delina twice and Lightning Runner once.
Resolve a Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of Aethertorch Renegade that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When the Aethertorch Renegade token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, causing you to get at least {E}{E}{E}{E}.

At the end of your combat phase, each creature token created by Delina triggers, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.
Once you have infinite {E}, you may target any other creature(s) you control.

Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Splendid Reclamation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Tatyova triggers, causing you to draw that many cards and gain that much life.

Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ratchet, Field Medic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Ratchet into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Choose not to return Ratchet to the command zone from your graveyard.
When the Ratchet, Field Medic token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
The Ratchet, Field Medic token triggers, causing you to convert it into Ratchet, Rescue Racer, and return Ratchet from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ratchet, Field Medic enters the battlefield, Preston and Soul Warden trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ratchet, Field Medic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Ratchet into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Choose not to return Ratchet to the command zone from your graveyard.
The Ratchet, Rescue Racer token triggers, as well as Soul Warden.
Resolve the Ratchet, Rescue Racer trigger, causing you to convert it into Ratchet, Field Medic.
Put one of the Ratchet, Field Medic tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 7.
